# Pwn Sampler
# category: Pwn
# type: StaticAttachment

Vulnerable C source (Dockerfile + binary in the real challenge):

```c
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){ char buf[64]; gets(buf); printf(buf); return 0; }
```

Compile with: gcc -fno-stack-protector -no-pie -o pwn pwn.c
